_comment: Curriculum-alignment roster for the foothill-neurodiagnostic-technology-top-121200 program evaluation. Foothill's program (A.S. with UCSF, first cohort expected fall 2027) has no courses yet, so the roster reads the two California programs under TOP 121200 — Orange Coast's and San Diego Mesa's associate degrees — against the detailed O*NET occupation the def's SOC 29-2099 reports; columns are labelled by certificate with the college prefixed. Readings are saved per program under saved_reports/alignment/.

programs.pairing_basis: The degree's stated purpose is preparing Neurodiagnostic Technologists (O*NET-SOC 29-2099.01). TOP 121200 crosswalks to CIP 51.0903 (Electroneurodiagnostic/Electroencephalographic Technology) and on to SOC 29-2099, Health Technologists and Technicians, All Other — the code the Centers of Excellence report demand under; 29-2099.01 is the detailed occupation inside it.

The degree's stated purpose is preparing Neurodiagnostic Technologists (O*NET-SOC 29-2099.01). TOP 121200 crosswalks to CIP 51.0903 (Electroneurodiagnostic/Electroencephalographic Technology) and on to SOC 29-2099, Health Technologists and Technicians, All Other — the code the Centers of Excellence report demand under; 29-2099.01 is the detailed occupation inside it.
